context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Reliable login trick when Playwright Connexion-modal click is flaky: use page.request.post /api/auth/login to get token, then page.evaluate(setItem('luminahr_auth_v3', JSON.stringify({token, user}))) and page.goto(BASE). 2) The Nouvelle livraison form does NOT expose <label htmlFor>; use input placeholder selectors (input[placeholder*='Gisèle Fortin'], input[placeholder*='Sainte-Catherine'], input[placeholder*='514-555']) rather than get_by_label. 3) Proof canvas testids: proof-dialog, proof-mode-photo, proof-mode-signature, proof-signature-canvas, proof-clear-signature, proof-confirm-button, delivery-proof-thumb-<id>, proof-view-dialog. Confirm button label switches between 'Confirmer la livraison' and 'Confirmer la livraison avec preuve' based on whether a drawing exists. 4) Drawing on canvas: bounding_box() then page.mouse.move(x,y) / mouse.down() / mouse.move(steps=6) / mouse.up() — the onPointerDown/Move/Up handlers accept synthetic mouse events. 5) 3MB payload cap on proof_image; must start with 'data:image/'; proof_type must be 'photo' or 'signature' when proof_image present.
